prompt_blocos.abertura: A whimsical, joyful and slightly surreal mid-century children's book illustration of
prompt_blocos.tom: The visual language should feel magical, playful and unusually colorful rather than nostalgic or autumnal.
prompt_blocos.cores: Use a bold, high-contrast, joyful color palette built around vivid turquoise and electric cyan contrasted with saturated coral-red, hot pink, sunny golden yellow and small accents of deep violet. Avoid muted earth tones, beige, mustard, burnt orange, olive, sepia and traditional autumn colors. The colors should feel like unexpected complementary opposites placed next to each other, creating a lively, almost candy-like visual rhythm.
prompt_blocos.tecnica: Flat gouache shapes with a subtly grainy, tactile printed texture, inspired by vintage screen printing but with a contemporary, energetic color sensibility. Almost no outlines.
prompt_blocos.personagem: Simple geometric rounded forms, playful asymmetry, slightly exaggerated proportions, oversized head, small body, rosy cheeks and tiny dot eyes. The character should feel charming, expressive and full of wonder. The facial expression should naturally match the action described above.
prompt_blocos.encantamento: Add a very few small abstract graphic accents — tiny sparkles, dots, droplets and short curved motion lines (just a few!) — placed directly on or around the exact part of the body or object that is performing the action, so they read as movement and energy. Keep them simple, flat and graphic. Do not invent or add any extra object, prop, toy, food, decoration or magical item that the action does not require: no wands, no balloons, no lollipops, no accessories in the hands. Ordinary things stay recognisably ordinary — the sparkle is movement, never a new thing.
prompt_blocos.enquadramento: Only the character and the few objects necessary for the action are shown. No landscape, no trees, no grass, no sky, no scenery and no environmental background. Everything outside the character and objects is pure solid white. Flat, even lighting, no cast shadow.
prompt_blocos.composicao: The composition should feel iconic and instantly readable, like a beautifully designed children's picture-book character plate or a collectible illustration. The subject is centred in the square frame and fills about 80% of the frame height, leaving a similar band of white space on every side, so that every illustration in the set is framed at exactly the same scale. Full body visible, strong silhouette, bold color blocking, sophisticated but innocent, whimsical, optimistic, strange in a charming way, visually memorable.
prompt_blocos.proibicoes: No text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no typography anywhere in the image.
